therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of Participants With Adverse Events (AEs) up to Day 98

results.effect_size: SAEs: 1/25 in 2.5 mg/kg/wk arm vs 2/25 in placebo; non-serious AEs: 11/25 in 2.5 mg/kg/wk arm vs 14/25 in placebo
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in AUC0-168hr,ss from 196 µg·h/mL (0.02 mg/kg/wk) to 18200 µg·h/mL (2.5 mg/kg/wk)
biomarker_changes: CRP decreased from baseline across all dose groups and placebo; 0.1 mg/kg/wk and 0.3 mg/kg/wk showed numerically greater CRP reductions (approximately -19 to -21 mg/dL) compared to placebo (-9 to -13 mg/dL) at most timepoints
SDAI improved from baseline in all arms including placebo; no clear dose-response advantage over placebo
DAS28-CRP improved from baseline in all arms; 0.3 mg/kg/wk showed numerically greater improvement at several timepoints
HAQ score improved modestly across arms; 2.5 mg/kg/wk showed numerically greater improvement (-0.71 to -0.75) compared to placebo (-0.28 to -0.31)
subgroup_findings: 0.3 mg/kg/wk showed the largest SDAI reduction at Day 7 (-22.59 vs placebo -8.46)
0.3 mg/kg/wk showed the largest DAS28 reduction at Day 7 (-1.66 vs placebo -0.61) and Day 63 (-2.17 vs placebo -0.82)
0.1 mg/kg/wk showed the largest DAS28 reduction at Day 98 (-2.25 vs placebo -1.11)
2.5 mg/kg/wk showed the largest HAQ improvement at all timepoints (-0.71 to -0.75 vs placebo -0.28 to -0.31)
safety_signals: SAEs occurred in 1/25 participants in the 2.5 mg/kg/wk arm (influenza, lower respiratory tract infection, hypertension) and 2/25 in placebo (myocardial infarction, peritonitis, femur fracture)
No SAEs in 0.1 mg/kg/wk or 1.0 mg/kg/wk arms
Overall AE profile appeared acceptable across dose levels
